events.title: Demo V1.2 Preview: Ancient Guardian Arrives for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Dice Ark is taking part in Steam Next Fest: October 2026! We plan to update the demo to V1.2 when the festival begins. Planned update time October 19, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT / 1:00 PM EDT / 17:00 UTC What’s planned for V1.2 New boss: Ancient Guardian joins the Sky Ruins. Watch for its unique omen events involving defense towers, ancient barriers, and combat records. events.summary: Thank you for playing Dice Ark! Here is a look at the main improvements and balance changes in Demo V1.1. Main changes Improved controls: We have refined game interactions for a smoother experience. events.title: After About Three Months in Beta, Dice Ark Becomes a Demo! Coming to Steam Next
events.summary: From Beta to Demo After About Three Months!The beta version of Dice Ark that you've been playing is becoming a demo after about three months of development and refinement! Thank you to everyone who played, shared impressions, and reported bugs. events.title: Free Demo Now Available!
events.summary: About the Beta:Game length is limited to the “Quick” setting.Local play supports 1–2 human players and 0–3 NPCs.Available jobs: Knight and Thief.Graphics, visual effects, and other presentation elements are still provisional.This demo is a work in progress. Its content may differ from the full version, and the demo may be withdrawn without prior notice.Stay tuned for the full release in July!
